name: Classic Children's Story
blurb: A public-domain tale, retold and filmed — cast, scenes, music and all.
detail: Name a story and it goes and finds the real thing: the Grimm, Aesop or Jacobs text that is out of copyright, not a summary of it. It keeps the shape audiences already know — the three attempts, the repeated line, the turn — writes it as dialogue a child can follow, casts and stages every character, and scores it. Ask for something that has no public-domain source and it will say so rather than inventing a folk tale.
